actions.description: Attach a file to a Jira issue
actions.name: add-attachment

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue to attach the file to. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

content.description: The file content as plain text or base64 encoded string

filename.description: The name of the file. Example: "document.pdf"

contentType.description: The MIME type of the file. Example: "application/pdf"

isBase64.description: Whether the content is base64 encoded. Defaults to false

actions.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue.
actions.name: add-comment

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue to add the comment to. Example: "PROJ-123" or "10001"

body.description: The plain text content of the comment to add.

id.description: The ID of the created comment.

self.description: The REST API URL of the comment.

updated.description: When the comment was last updated.

actions.description: Add a watcher to a Jira issue
actions.name: add-watcher

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue to add the watcher to. Example: "PROJ-123" or "10001"

accountId.description: The account ID of the user to add as a watcher. Example: "5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5"

actions.description: Log time against a Jira issue.
actions.name: add-worklog

issue_id_or_key.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10002" or "PROJ-123"

time_spent_seconds.description: The time spent working on the issue in seconds. Example: 12000 (for 3h 20m)

started.description: The date/time when the work was started. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2021-01-17T12:34:00.000+0000"

comment.description: A comment about the work done. This is a plain text that will be converted to Atlassian Document Format.

actions.description: Link two Jira issues with a relationship type
actions.name: create-issue-link

type.description: The name of the issue link type. Example: "Blocks"

inwardIssueKey.description: The issue key for the inward side of the link (the issue that depends on or is affected by the other). Example: "PROJ-123"

outwardIssueKey.description: The issue key for the outward side of the link (the issue that affects or blocks the other). Example: "PROJ-456"

actions.description: Create a Jira issue in a project.
actions.name: create-issue

actions.description: Delete an attachment from a Jira issue
actions.name: delete-attachment

id.description: The ID of the attachment to delete. Example: "10001"

actions.description: Delete a comment from a Jira issue
actions.name: delete-comment

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "PROJ-123"

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "10000"

cloudId.description: Optional Jira cloud ID. If not provided, will be resolved from connection.

baseUrl.description: Optional Jira base URL. If not provided, will be resolved from connection.

actions.description: Delete a link between Jira issues
actions.name: delete-issue-link

linkId.description: The ID of the issue link to delete. Example: "10001"

actions.description: Delete a Jira issue by ID or key
actions.name: delete-issue

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue to delete. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

deleteSubtasks.description: If true, subtasks are also deleted. Defaults to false.

actions.description: Delete a worklog from a Jira issue.
actions.name: delete-worklog

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10032" or "PROJ-123"

worklogId.description: The ID of the worklog to delete. Example: "10011"

actions.description: Retrieve project and issue type metadata for issue creation.
actions.name: get-create-issue-metadata

projectIds.description: List of project IDs to filter by. Example: ["10000", "10001"]

projectKeys.description: List of project keys to filter by. Example: ["PROJ", "TEST"]

issuetypeIds.description: List of issue type IDs to filter by. Example: ["10000", "10001"]

expand.description: Use expand to include additional information about issue metadata in the response. Supported values: projects, projects.issuetypes, projects.issuetypes.fields

actions.description: Retrieve editable field metadata for an existing Jira issue
actions.name: get-edit-issue-metadata

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10000" or "PROJ-123"

actions.description: Retrieve Jira field metadata by field ID
actions.name: get-field

fieldId.description: The ID of the field to retrieve. For example: "summary", "description", or "customfield_10101"

actions.description: Retrieve the changelog for a Jira issue
actions.name: get-issue-changelog

actions.description: Retrieve Jira issue type metadata by issue type ID.
actions.name: get-issue-type

id.description: The ID of the issue type to retrieve.

actions.description: Retrieve a Jira issue by ID or key
actions.name: get-issue

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue to retrieve. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Example: "summary,description,status"

expand.description: Comma-separated list of fields to expand. Example: "renderedFields,names,schema"

properties.description: Comma-separated list of issue property keys to return. Example: "property1,property2"

id.description: The unique identifier of the issue

self.description: The REST API URL of the issue

actions.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated Jira user.
actions.name: get-myself

account_id.description: The account ID of the user. Example: "5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5"

display_name.description: The display name of the user. Example: "John Doe"

email_address.description: The email address of the user. Example: "john.doe@example.com"

time_zone.description: The time zone of the user. Example: "Europe/Berlin"

locale.description: The locale of the user. Example: "en_US"

active.description: Whether the user is active. Example: true

actions.description: Retrieve a Jira priority by priority ID.
actions.name: get-priority

actions.description: Retrieve a Jira project by ID or key.
actions.name: get-project

projectIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the project to retrieve. Example: "10000" or "PROJ"

actions.description: Retrieve a Jira status by status ID or name.
actions.name: get-status

statusIdOrName.description: Status ID or name. Example: "10001" or "To Do"

actions.description: Retrieve a Jira user by account ID
actions.name: get-user

accountId.description: The account ID of the user to retrieve. Example: "5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5"

expand.description: Additional user details to include in the response. Comma-separated list of: groups, applicationRoles. Example: "groups,applicationRoles"

actions.description: List Jira field metadata available to the user.
actions.name: list-fields

actions.description: List comments on a Jira issue with pagination
actions.name: list-issue-comments

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results. Example: 0

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Example: 50

orderBy.description: Order comments by created or updated date. Use - prefix for descending order.

expand.description: A comma-separated list of fields to expand in the response. Example: "renderedBody"

actions.description: List Jira issue types available to the user
actions.name: list-issue-types

actions.description: List Jira priorities available to the user.
actions.name: list-priorities

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List components for a Jira project
actions.name: list-project-components

projectIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the project to list components for. Example: "10000" or "PROJ"

project.description: Project key the component belongs to

projectId.description: Project ID the component belongs to

assigneeType.description: Type of assignee for this component

leadAccountId.description: Account ID of the component lead

isAssigneeTypeValid.description: Whether the assignee type is valid

actions.description: List versions for a Jira project
actions.name: list-project-versions

projectIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the project. Example: "PROJ" or "10000"

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return. Default: 0

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 50

orderBy.description: Order the results by a field. Default: name

query.description: Filter the results using a literal string. Versions with matching names or descriptions are returned

actions.description: List Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user.
actions.name: list-projects

query.description: Filter projects by name or key. Example: "PROJ"

categoryId.description: Filter by project category ID. Example: 10000

actions.description: List Jira statuses available to the user
actions.name: list-statuses

projectId.description: Project ID to filter statuses. Example: "10000"

searchString.description: Search string to filter statuses by name

actions.description: List available workflow transitions for a Jira issue
actions.name: list-transitions

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "PROJ-123" or "10001"

expand.description: Additional fields to expand in the response

to.description: The status the transition moves the issue to

transitions.description: Available workflow transitions for the issue

actions.description: Search Jira users visible to the authenticated account.
actions.name: list-users

query.description: A query string used to search user attributes. Matches against users visible to the authenticated account.

accountId.description: A users accountId to filter the search results. Example: "5b10a2844c20165700ede21g"

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return in the results. Default: 0

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 50, Maximum: 1000

actions.description: List watchers on a Jira issue
actions.name: list-watchers

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

actions.description: List worklogs on a Jira issue
actions.name: list-worklogs

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "PROJ-123" or "10001"

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results. Default: 0

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Default: 50

actions.description: Remove a watcher from a Jira issue
actions.name: remove-watcher

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

accountId.description: The accountId of the user to remove as a watcher. Example: "5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5"

success.description: Whether the watcher was successfully removed

issueIdOrKey.description: The issue ID or key that was modified

actions.description: Search Jira issues using JQL.

jql.description: JQL query string to search for issues. Example: "project = PROJ AND status = Open"

fields.description: Array of fields to return for each issue. Defaults to a set of common fields.

expand.description: Array of fields to expand in the response. Example: ["changelog", "renderedFields"]

startAt.description: Index of the first item to return. Used for offset pagination.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default varies by server.

actions.description: Move a Jira issue through a workflow transition.
actions.name: transition-issue

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "PROJ-123"

transitionId.description: The ID of the transition to perform. Example: "31"

actions.name: update-comment

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue ID or key. Example: "10001" or "PROJ-123"

notifyUsers.description: Notify users about the comment update

actions.description: Update a worklog on a Jira issue.
actions.name: update-worklog

issueIdOrKey.description: The ID or key of the issue. Example: "10002" or "PROJ-123"
